headline: The logo sequence has no timed advance. It advances from the end-of-movie trampoline 00685060, installed on the movie player 00E18D48 by BSP_LogoSequence_AdvanceOrFinish before each entry starts. The float at logo+78h is the minimum age before a manual skip is accepted, not a timeout. This resolves the open question in docs/GAME_FRONTEND_STATES.md.
